//#lint:check.description: Whole-repo oxlint pass, human format. Uncached: typeAware lint depends on the entire tsconfig graph plus the Tailwind entry point, so an under-specified input hash would cache a pass over code that was never linted.

//#lint:agent.description: Same pass with --format=agent - the machine-readable form agents parse.

//#format:check.description: Whole-repo oxfmt --check. Uncached until its inputs are authored and verified against --dry=json.

//#knip.description: Unused files, exports, and dependencies across every workspace. Uncached until its inputs are authored and verified against --dry=json.

//#knip:production.description: Knip --production --strict: shipped-code-only pass plus workspace isolation.

//#deps:check.description: syncpack lint: catalog: specifiers for third-party deps, workspace:* for internal links. Cached: syncpack reads only the workspace manifests, the workspace catalog, and its rc file, so these inputs are the complete hash (verified with --dry-run=json; a bare **/package.json glob would pull in nested node_modules). Extend the manifest globs if pnpm-workspace.yaml ever adds a workspace directory.

//#deps:format:check.description: syncpack format --check: package.json field ordering. Run pnpm deps:format to fix. Cached with the same complete input set as //#deps:check.

transit.description: Internal no-op graph edge (transit-node pattern). Propagates source changes through declared workspace dependencies without serializing check-types tasks. App-to-app service bindings are not package dependencies and require an explicit callee#transit edge in the caller's package configuration.

check-types.description: Type-check with tsc --noEmit. Uses the transit node (not ^check-types) so packages run in parallel while still invalidating when dependency source changes. JIT packages export source .ts directly, so no declaration emit or project references. No `types` edge: worker-configuration.d.ts is committed, so it is a tracked $TURBO_DEFAULT$ input and hashes directly - regenerating it here would dirty the tree mid-CI.

types.description: Regenerate the committed worker-configuration.d.ts (wrangler types). Writes a tracked source file, so it is uncached like the other write-mode tasks - run it after editing wrangler.jsonc, then commit the result. CI verifies freshness with types:check instead of running this.

types:check.description: Verify the committed worker-configuration.d.ts still matches wrangler.jsonc (wrangler types --check). Read-only and cached; fails when the file has drifted, prompting `pnpm types` + commit. Unlike `types`, --check does not start workerd, so it is cheap in CI.

build.description: Build production output to dist/; gated on the package's own check-types and upstream builds.

test.description: Run Vitest for the package (Workers pool for worker-* apps; Node for front-*).

test:watch.description: Vitest watch mode (persistent, uncached). Humans only - agents must use the test task.

dev.description: Run the local dev server (persistent, uncached).

preview.description: Serve the production build locally (persistent, uncached).

deploy.description: wrangler deploy --env production (upload + immediate 100%). Local/bootstrap; GitHub CD uses versions upload + versions deploy.

upload.description: wrangler versions upload --env production (no traffic change).

promote.description: wrangler versions deploy --env production (interactive local promote/rollback helper).
